messages.en:
{07 16 00}You're all business all the
time, huh! {01 01 00}{07 0b 00}Can we do it
later?
{07 00 00}I read in {ff 00 00 02}Ms. Nintendique{ff 00 00 00}
that rushing all the time
causes eyelashes to uncurl.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Sa oled kogu aeg ainult
asjalik, mis! {01 01 00}{07 0b 00}Kas teeme
hiljem? Lugesin
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 02}preili Nintendique'ist{ff 00 00 00},
et pidev kiirustamine
sirgestab ripsmeid.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Hey, {01 00 00 0a 00}do you mind if we
make it a little later?

{07 1b 00}I'm making an occasion of
this.{01 00 00 05 00} I need time to
primp, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kuule, {01 00 00 0a 00}kas sa ei paneks
pahaks, kui teeksime
hiljem? 
{07 1b 00}Ma teen sellest sündmuse.{01 00 00 05 00}
Mul on vaja aega end
sättida, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
